title: Older brother John Garland and his instruments
summary: His older brother John, now ill in Philadelphia, played violin, trombone, mandolin and guitar; only he and Ed survive.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
